_meta.name: Munro Wilson Limited brand specification
_meta.derivedFrom: Colour and type values sampled from Munro Wilson - PV Scope - SC52A v4.docx; logo colours sampled from MunroWFinal.png artwork.

logoPrimary.note: 1768x418 RGBA, true alpha. Grey wordmark, blue mark. White and pale backgrounds ONLY.

logoReversed.note: NOT SUPPLIED. Needed for any dark or navy background. See _issues.

favicon.note: Web favicon only. Unusable in documents. Filename contains a space.

accreditations.label: NICEIC Approved Contractor
accreditations.note: 1080x1080 canvas, artwork occupies only 848x490 of it. Must be trimmed to the alpha bounding box or it renders tiny beside the others.

accreditations.label: MCS Certified
accreditations.note: MCS Certified mark, black on transparent. Filename is a CMS export artifact; rename to mcs-certified-black.png in the repo and update this entry.

accreditations.label: Certified B Corporation
accreditations.note: Tall narrow mark. Scaled slightly down so it does not dominate the strip at equal height. White variant available for dark backgrounds.

badgeStrip.caption: NICEIC Approved Contractor  |  MCS Certified  |  Certified B Corporation

colour.navyNote: Primary brand navy. Section bands, headings, table header fill.
colour.tintPaleNote: Callout boxes and alternating table fill.

type.sizesNote: Points. docx-js takes half-points, so multiply by 2.

furniture.footerCentre: {{CONFIDENTIALITY}}  |  Ref: {{DOCUMENT_REF}}  |  Issue: {{ISSUE_DATE}}  |  Page N of M
furniture.registrationLineNote: NOT SUPPLIED. Company number, VAT number, NICEIC and MCS registration numbers as worded on invoices.

_issues: Grey wordmark #A7A9AC on navy #1F5C8B gives 3.01:1 contrast, below the 4.5:1 readability threshold. A reversed white-wordmark logo is required before the Munro Wilson logo can sit on a navy panel.

The source document embeds the logo as a JPEG with the alpha flattened to black, then relies on Word's Set Transparent Color (a:clrChange) to knock the black out. Fragile. The template uses the true RGBA PNG instead.
MCS and NICEIC marks are black-on-transparent with no white variant supplied, so the badge strip can only sit on a white or pale background. Only B-Corp has a reversed variant.

niceic_app_contractor.png carries roughly 40 percent transparent padding on a square canvas. The build trims to the alpha bounding box at run time, but a pre-trimmed file in the repo would be cleaner.
image-808x1024.png should be renamed mcs-certified-black.png in the repo.
These source files are not in the brand repo. They were lost once already when the build environment reset. Commit brand.json, brand.js and the build scripts alongside the assets.

Stored quote convention describes a full-bleed two-panel navy/white cover. The source document uses a centred logo with navy title bands. The template follows the source document. Confirm which is the house standard.
Quote convention requires each numbered section to start on a new page. NOT yet implemented in these components; see pageBreakBeforeSections in build options.
